attacks.name: Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
After this attack is resolved, if the defender is |!size| 3 or less, Push it Away |!range_small|.

attacks.name: Shield Throw
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
This attack ignores LOS, and the defender does not benefit from cover.

|!wild| |*Ricochet|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make an additional |*Shield Throw| attack. This attack must target another character that is within |!range| 3 of the original defender and may be any distance from this character. This additional attack does not have the |*Ricochet| special rule.

attacks.name: Siberian Shield Slam
steps: Before |!damage| is dealt, if the defender is |!size| 3 or less, this character may Throw it |!range_small|.

superPowers.name: Focused Repulsion Field
superPowers.body: When this character is targeted by a |!physical| or |!energy| attack, it may use this superpower. This character adds blanks in its defense roll to its total successes.

superPowers.name: Red Guardian‘s Suit
superPowers.body: When this character is damaged by an enemy or allied effect, after the effect is resolved, if this character is not Dazed it gains 1 |!power|.
